questions.question: What did the adversaries of Judah do?
options: Sent generous gifts of gold and silver to help support the building
Joined with the people and helped them to build the temple of God
Withdrew quite peacefully and left the builders entirely alone
Discouraged the people and hired counselors to frustrate the work
questions.answer: Discouraged the people and hired counselors to frustrate the work
